assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
The diagnosis of atherosclerotic heart disease is coded I25.10.
The diagnosis of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded with CPT 93229.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
SilverBridge Advantage requires all such diagnostic monitoring services to be pre-approved to ensure medical necessity and coverage eligibility.
